Title: Any rules on what is an electronic device yet?

Messages.Author: Omael
Messages.Body:
I just wanted a list of cards that are burned by smite.
Are they limited to equipment?

Messages.Author: Salem
Messages.Body:
Omael wrote:
> I just wanted a list of cards that are burned by smite.
> Are they limited to equipment?

Card text obviously limits it to equipment.

The 'electronic' bit seems to be the new trait.

Traditionally, when a new trait is introduced, the card that affects it
lists all the current cards it affects in brackets, and new cards
printed later will come with the trait as appropriate (with reprints of
the previous cards gaining the trait on reprint).

This is how it seemed to work with the trait Werewolf (when Abomination,
the action card, was first printed).

So I'd guess only the few things listed on Smite are currently
considered 'electronic equipment'. (IR goggles, Laptop Computer, Phased
Motion Detector).
